### Crypt

One sarcophagus, lid askew, and a word cut deep into the niche above it.

| Line | Reads |
| ---- | ----- |
| 1    | ashes keep their own accounts |
| 2    | say this at the black door |

```
marrowlight
```

Touching the lid feels like putting your hand into cold water that pushes back.

choices.text: Lay your hand on the sarcophagus
Climb out to the iron door
